statement: For every connected non-tree finite simple graph G on exactly eight vertices, every unordered genuine nonedge {u,v}, and every starting vertex s in V(G), the expected discrete-time simple-random-walk cover times satisfy t_cov(G+uv,s) != t_cov(G,s), where the start is visited at time zero and time is counted in edge transitions.
contribution: An exhaustive exact finite-field computation resolves the full frozen order-eight fixed-start layer: 11,094 unlabelled connected cyclic graphs, all 150,573 nonedges, and all 1,204,584 marked starts were covered directly, with two exact solver formulations, no singular systems at two checked primes, zero equality residues, exact-rational regression tests, hashed inventory and metadata, and a clean reproduction. This does not settle any higher-order, tree, worst-start, or unrestricted claim.
